opportunities.name: Book + film + note research (Gutenberg & IMDb)
opportunities.description: For a book title, find it on Project Gutenberg (author, downloads), look up the film on IMDb (year, rating), and add a Unit note to Notes.
steps: Search the title in the Gutenberg quick search and open the top result
Search the same title on IMDb and open the matching film
In Notes, add a note: 'Unit: <title> by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>'

opportunities.name: Country geography note (Wikipedia & timeanddate)
opportunities.description: For a country, get facts from Wikipedia, find the capital's local time on timeanddate, and add a Geography note.
steps: Search the country on Wikipedia and read population, languages, currency
Search the capital on timeanddate and open the matching city
In Notes, add 'Geography: <country>, capital <capital>, pop <pop>, <languages>, <currency>, time now <time>'
